title: Sing praises unto God Sing
lyrics_original: Sing praises unto God Sing praises
Sing praises unto God Sing praises
Sing praises unto God Sing praises, Hallelujah!
For God is our King Over all the earth
Sing praises unto Him With understanding
So clap your hands and shout all thy people
For He is to be praised To be praised

bible_verses.english: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises! For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
Let everything that has breath praise Yahweh! Praise Yah!

devotional.prayer_english: Lord, You are the King over all the earth, great and worthy of all our praise. Today, I come before You with a joyful heart, lifting my voice and praising You with understanding. Thank You for Your loving reign in my life and for Your constant faithfulness. Fill my spirit with Your joy, and let my life be a continuous song of gratitude to You. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord, You are the King over all the earth, great and worthy of all our praise. Today, I come before You with a joyful heart, lifting my voice and praising You with understanding. Thank You for Your loving reign in my life and for Your constant faithfulness. Fill my spirit with Your joy, and let my life be a continuous song of gratitude to You. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: When we lift our voices in praise, we align our hearts with the glorious reality that God reigns supreme over all the earth. This joyful call to worship invites us not just to sing, but to sing with understanding—recognizing His immense goodness, majesty, and love. As we clap our hands and offer Him our heartfelt gratitude, our faith is refreshed and our spirits are lifted. Let us respond today by offering Him the honor He so richly deserves.
